annotation.title_clean: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.title_en: Law No. (9) of 2023 Regulating the Operation of Autonomous Vehicles in the Emirate of Dubai
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ruler of Dubai (Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum); Supreme Legislation Committee in the Emirate of Dubai
named_instruments_referenced: Executive Council Resolution No. (3) of 2019 on Autonomous Vehicle Test Runs
UAE Federal Law No. 21 of 1995 on Road Traffic
annotation.summary_en: Dubai Law No. 9 of 2023 regulates the operation of autonomous vehicles in the Emirate. It gives the Roads and Transport Authority power to license vehicles, permit operators and activities, set technical standards, inspect, handle data and complaints, and apply the federal traffic law where the Law is silent.
key_provisions_or_claims: No autonomous vehicle may travel on a road without an RTA licence.
No person may conduct an autonomous-vehicle activity without an RTA permit; vehicles licensed elsewhere in the UAE also need a Dubai permit.
RTA sets technical standards, inspects vehicles, monitors permit holders and handles complaints.
RTA compiles and classifies data generated by autonomous vehicle operation.
Federal Road Traffic Law applies where this Law is silent, taking into account the nature of autonomous vehicles.
